note: Saint Lucia: nationals of the other OECS states move freely; nationals of the countries and territories listed enter without a visa for 90 days in 180 (the Schengen states and the EU but Ireland, and Serbia), 60 days (the UAE), 6 weeks or 15 days (Singapore), or get a 6-week visa on arrival. Everyone else needs a visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Department of External Affairs' own table (last updated November 2018): it confirmed who needs no visa and who gets one at the port of entry, without the stays, and marks Serbia as needing one before arrival and Singapore 'YES (up to 15 days)'. Serbia's exemption is later than the table, and Singapore's reading is ambiguous, so both, and the stays, stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.said: Visitors to Saint Lucia must obtain a visa unless they are citizens from one of the visa-exempt countries or citizens who may obtain a visa on arrival. ...
